processNotes.reviewResultTrap: A review workflow returning an EMPTY finding set may mean the LENSES CRASHED, not that the diff is clean. Check the run's failures list + journal.jsonl before treating empty as a pass (seen at 9.3).
processNotes.firstImplementerTrap: A subagent can return an anomalous 0-edit 'done'. ALWAYS verify the tree (git status + run the test) before trusting green (seen at 9.1).
processNotes.reviewFixRevertTrap: When recording revertAssertion rows, VERIFY the revert actually re-reds the named test. At 9.4a, removing the !edge.repairable branch did NOT re-red [C032-D1] (that test configures testRepairAttempts:0, where the repair path blocks immediately anyway); the redAdmission change is what re-reds it, and that is what the row now cites.
processNotes.userParallelWork: The user commits their own work on main concurrently (llama-conductor rename, submodule pointers, presets, docs). ALWAYS git add explicit paths, never -A, and never revert their files.
